text_block_list.text:
The busy days aimed at defeating Almond 
Eye continued—and then one day.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Now, today's guest is Daring Tact, who 
achieved the Tiara double crown with her 
victory at the Yushun Himba (Japanese 
Oaks)!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Tact, who has achieved an incredible 
feat by capturing two crowns while 
remaining undefeated.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Even with heavy marking in the Oaks, she 
showed off a magnificent burst of speed in 
the final stretch, and her tremendous 
mental fortitude is drawing lots of 
attention.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You flatter me with such kind words. 
...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"I want to deliver good news back home 
from the Shuka Sho as well."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Tact-san's strength at the Oaks was the 
talk of our whole class."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Her sheer skill aside— the grit to keep 
winning without succumbing to the pressure 
of an undefeated streak... is truly 
magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's still a ways off, but—Tact-san might 
actually run in the Japan Cup too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"If it's not just Ai-san, but Tact-san as 
well, then—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup looks set to become a 
magnificent garden— where great blossoms 
bloom in profusion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Um, starting today, would it be alright if 
you checked over my self-training routine 
too...?

...And then, the day of the All Comers 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Curren Bouquetd'or! I wonder if 
Trainer <username> is around here too?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"I'm lookin' forward to today's race too! 
Give it all you've got—!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"‘Seize your dream, Bouquet!!’ ‘We're 
rooting for you--!!’"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes—thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, the cheers for the steadfast Curren 
Bouquetd'or are absolutely deafening!

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Her fighting spirit shown in the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) and the Takarazuka Kinen left a 
deep impression. I'm very much looking 
forward to today's race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(To fight against Ai-san in the Japan 
Cup—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I will give it my all and run straight 
through to the end—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the stage is set. The GII 2200m turf 
race, the Sankei Sho All Comers, is about 
to begin—!
